_comment: The application answer bank. The apply runner maps form labels to these keys; an empty value counts as no answer, so a required question about it stops the run and goes to the user. learned[] grows with the user's answers to new questions (npm run apply -- learn). Personal data: never on a CV, the tracker or a committed file.

eeo._why: Self-identification answers. 'decline' picks the form's decline-to-answer option. Change a value only on the user's explicit word.
